name: CBA Spring Sucre 2025

venue.name: CBA Sucre

information:
This is the fourth official tournament in Bolivia’s capital, hosted at the Bolivian American Center. The competition is open to the public. For details on registration and payment, please visit the following [link](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/CBASpringSucre2025#61836-instrucciones-de-pago)

**More information about the competitions enter to: [Frequently Asked Questions / FAQ]   (https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/CBASpringSucre2025#61834-faq-pmf)**

Este es el cuarto torneo oficial en la capital de Bolivia, organizado en el Centro Boliviano Americano. La competencia está abierta al público. Para obtener información sobre el registro y el pago, visita el siguiente [Enlace](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/CBASpringSucre2025#61836-instrucciones-de-pago)
